notes.title: 🔥 Steam Next Fest Begins: Test the Demo of "The Witch's Redemption" Now!
notes.content:
The highly anticipated Steam Next Fest has kicked off, and we are thrilled to invite you to experience the demo version of "The Witch’s Redemption." This is a unique opportunity to delve into a world where every choice matters and every action has consequences. From June 10th to June 17th, immerse yourself in the enchanting and treacherous journey of Alice, a witch seeking redemption in a land rife with secrets and dangers.

What to Expect:
- Engaging Demo: Get hands-on with the demo and explore the initial chapters of Alice's adventure. Discover the captivating story, interact with intriguing characters, and experience the strategic combat system that will challenge your tactical thinking.

- Live Streams: Join our live streams during Steam Next Fest to see exclusive gameplay, and get insider insights into the creation of "The Witch’s Redemption." 


- Add to Wishlist: Make sure to add "The Witch’s Redemption" to your Steam wishlist to stay updated on all future announcements, release dates, and special offers. Your support helps us bring this enchanting tale to life and ensures you won't miss any critical updates.

Don’t miss out on this chance to be among the first to experience "The Witch’s Redemption." Download the demo, join our live streams, and WISHLIST the game today!
